headline: 10–30s videos deliver a 3.44× median view lift—the single biggest lever in skincare content this week.
moves: Cut your next skincare routine to 10–30 seconds: this format has a 3.44× lift (n=17) and appears in 29% of top-quartile videos vs. only 5% of bottom-quartile.
Add an on-screen text hook in the first 3 seconds: 2.56× lift (n=58), present in 76% of top-quartile vs. 48% of bottom-quartile videos.
Show hands + product on camera: 2.44× lift (n=61), seen in 86% of top-quartile vs. 52% of bottom-quartile videos.
avoid: Stop using a direct 'you' hook—it underperforms at 0.35× lift (n=16).
hooks: My 10-second skincare fix for glass skin.
